consent.text: Morning. You're welcome to stop for a chat if you like.
consent.zh: 早上好。如果你愿意，可以停下来聊聊。

consent.text: Hello. Would you like to chat for a moment?
Hi there. No pressure, but I'm happy to talk.
consent.zh: 嗨。别有压力，不过我很愿意聊聊。

chat.text: The rain has eased off at last.
The high street is busy today.
chat.zh: 今天这条商业街挺热闹的。

chat.text: Your shop window looks bright today.
chat.zh: 你的店铺橱窗今天看起来很亮堂。

chat.text: This is a quieter corner when the traffic settles.
chat.zh: 车流少一点时，这个街角会安静些。

needs.text: A hot tea would be useful, if that's all right.
needs.zh: 如果方便的话，一杯热茶会很有用。

needs.text: Thanks for asking. It helps when people ask what I need.
needs.zh: 谢谢你先问我。大家先问我需要什么，这很有帮助。

dog.text: This is Patch. We look out for each other.
dog.zh: 这是 Patch。我们互相照顾。

dog.text: Please ask me before petting Patch.
dog.zh: 摸 Patch 之前，请先问问我。

dog.text: Patch is friendly, but please let Patch come to you.
dog.zh: Patch 很友好，不过请让 Patch 自己走近你。

donationOne.text: That's kind of you. Thank you for the pound.
donationOne.zh: 你真好。谢谢你给的一英镑。

donationOne.text: Thank you. That will help today.
donationOne.zh: 谢谢你。这对今天很有帮助。

donationTwo.text: That's generous. Thank you very much.
Two pounds will really help today. Thank you.
donationTwo.zh: 两英镑今天会帮上大忙。谢谢你。

alreadyHelped.text: You've already helped today. That's more than enough.
alreadyHelped.zh: 你今天已经帮过忙了。这已经足够了。

alreadyHelped.text: You've helped already, but a chat is always welcome.
alreadyHelped.zh: 你已经帮过我了，不过随时欢迎来聊聊。

noDonation.text: No worries. It was good to chat.
noDonation.zh: 没关系。和你聊聊就很好。

noDonation.text: That's all right. Take care today.

outreach.text: The local outreach team knows this area.
outreach.zh: 当地外展服务团队了解这片区域。

outreach.text: Please ask me before contacting a service for me.
outreach.zh: 在替我联系服务机构前，请先问问我。

consent.text: Morning. Would you like to stop and chat?
consent.zh: 早上好。愿意停下来聊聊吗？

consent.text: Hello. I'm happy to talk if you have a moment.
consent.zh: 你好。如果你有空，我很愿意聊聊。

consent.text: Hi. A quick chat would be nice, but it's your choice.
consent.zh: 嗨。能简单聊聊很好，不过由你决定。

chat.text: Those clouds look ready for more rain.
chat.zh: 那些云看着像是还要下雨。

chat.text: There have been plenty of deliveries along the street today.
chat.zh: 今天这条街上送货的车可真不少。

chat.text: A familiar face makes the street feel friendlier.
chat.zh: 看见熟悉的面孔，这条街会显得更亲切。

chat.text: It is good to see the little shop open.
chat.zh: 看到这家小店开门真好。

needs.text: A bottle of water would be useful, if you have one.
needs.zh: 如果你有的话，一瓶水会很有用。

needs.text: Thank you for asking instead of guessing.
needs.zh: 谢谢你先问我，而不是自己猜。

donationOne.text: Thank you for the pound. That's very kind.
donationOne.zh: 谢谢你给的一英镑。你真好。

donationOne.text: Thank you. That will be useful today.
donationOne.zh: 谢谢你。这今天会很有用。

donationTwo.text: Thank you. Two pounds is very kind of you.
donationTwo.zh: 谢谢你。你愿意给两英镑，真的很好。

donationTwo.text: I appreciate that. Thank you very much.

alreadyHelped.text: You have already helped today. Please keep the rest.
alreadyHelped.zh: 你今天已经帮过忙了。剩下的请自己留着吧。

alreadyHelped.text: You have helped already. The company is enough.
alreadyHelped.zh: 你已经帮过我了。有人聊聊就足够了。

noDonation.text: That's completely fine. Thanks for stopping.
noDonation.zh: 完全没关系。谢谢你愿意停下来。

noDonation.text: No problem. It was good to chat.
noDonation.zh: 没问题。和你聊聊就很好。

outreach.text: I know where to find the local outreach information.
outreach.zh: 我知道在哪里能找到当地外展服务的信息。

outreach.text: Please check with me before contacting anyone on my behalf.
outreach.zh: 在代表我联系任何人之前，请先征求我的意见。
